t: Al-Harrah战役结束,亚齐德一世的军队杀死了麦地那城的11000人.
te: The Battle of al-Harrah concludes, with Yazid I's army killing 11,000 people of the city of Medina.
dz: Al-Harrah战役结束,亚齐德一世的军队杀死了麦地那城的11000人.

t: 在围攻麦加期间,卡巴号起火并被烧毁.
te: During the Siege of Mecca, the Kaaba catches fire and is burned down.
